purpose: Evidence table prepared before slides. Paper claims, code, executed evaluation and recommended target are separate fields. UNKNOWN is not a negative result.

records.conclusion_scope: Nonlinear recovery outside stated linear protection. Native check met on fitted maps. No theorem refutation.

records.paper_states: Data producer gives representation to potentially malicious consumers. Certificate covers any classifier of finite representation.
records.code_implements: Official tree exports cell-median embeddings and downstream eval supports multiple classifier families. Our representation uses one-hot cell index.
records.our_evaluation: E2-E4 apply FARE to stored representations, tune against reader validation, compare matched zero-fairness tree.
records.recommended_target: Consumer with only cell, or own-head output computed solely from cell, remains within surface.
records.actor_and_objective: Data consumer making predictions and potentially inferring protected group.
records.released_object: Finite cell representation. Own-head output is a function of cell.
records.target_person_data: Cell or its function only unless contract adds another surface.
records.model_access: No weights or queries required. FARE tree is not an attacker input in our bank.
records.defense_knowledge: Any downstream classifier contemplated by certificate. Code exports labels for evaluation, not proof consumers possess them.
records.auxiliary_sensitive_labels: Our same-population labelled release sample is granted. Paper practical acquisition unspecified.
records.role_separation: Owner tree fitting and certification are separate. Our configuration selection also uses attacker_val feedback.
records.linkage_and_queries: One cell per target. Clean bypass or second-purpose output is additional access.
records.attack_fit_and_selection: Our bank selects log loss; FARE configuration uses validation NL AUC subject to probe utility.
records.recovery_and_usefulness: Certificate is demographic-parity distance, not our macro-AUC. Certification often unavailable/weak at our sizes.
records.conclusion_scope: No certified-scope contradiction established. Additional clean output is uncovered surface. Certificate usefulness unresolved here.

records.model_access: Black-box encoder oracle on auxiliary inputs in paper. Not inference white-box.
records.defense_knowledge: No fitted defense parameters required by inference description.
records.auxiliary_sensitive_labels: Paper auxiliary size50% of target-model training size, auxiliary data need not be same dataset.
records.role_separation: Paper target split80/20. Our explicit separate reader selection is not attributed to paper.

records.attack_fit_and_selection: Supervised inference model. Model repurposing has separate stronger model access.
records.recovery_and_usefulness: Paper accuracy. Our macro-AUC is different endpoint.
records.conclusion_scope: Precedent, not a new adversary. Different auxiliary/query assumptions, not globally stronger/weaker.
